title: canvas2D setTransform and doubles

labels.name: compat
labels.description: Standard is not web compatible or proprietary feature needs standardizing

body:
[The specs text][1] define `CanvasTransform.setTransform()` as accepting "unrestricted double".  
This corresponds to what the DOMMatrix interface also supports which is great.  

Implementers seem to follow this definition too ([FF][2], [Chrome][3]), which is also great...  
... except that a few lines later they do [clamp it to float][4] anyway.

This means that if we use a double that doesn't fit as a float in a DOMMatrix, set the canvas transform using this DOMMatrix and get back the canvas' current DOMMatrix calling `getTransform()`, we receive a DOMMatrix with clamped values [(live fiddle)][5].  

    const mat = new DOMMatrix();
    mat.a = 16777215.123;
    ctx.setTransform( mat );
    ctx.getTransform(); // -> { a: 16777215, ...

While not a *big* deal, as an user it's quite surprising (I am coming here after [a StackOverflow question][6] popped out).  

I am not sure what should be done here, but I decided to open the issue directly here because the implementations actually, somehow follow the specs.  
What I think would be acceptable changes from the top of my head:

 - Add a non-normative web-dev note about the fact implementers may clamp these values internally
 - Changing the definition of `CanvasTransform.setTransform()` so it accepts floats directly
 - Ask the implementers to not clamp to float, but that seems quite unreasonable...

cc @whatwg/canvas

[1]: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#canvastransform
[2]: https://searchfox.org/mozilla-central/rev/47db1be98f8069b387ce07dcbea22d09f1854515/dom/canvas/CanvasRenderingContext2D.cpp#2230
[3]: https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/main:third_party/blink/renderer/modules/canvas/canvas2d/base_rendering_context_2d.cc;l=1173;drc=e6d0975f7fd8f8c593ca2904e8f913c427cfc8cc
[4]: https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/main:third_party/blink/renderer/modules/canvas/canvas2d/base_rendering_context_2d.cc;l=1115;drc=a009c99eedf0ee26bfbf0dd0cfef48c7db4cc679
[5]: https://jsfiddle.net/63vsz8b9/
[6]: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/62462367/
